preRestore.name: add cockpit user
preRestore.command: useradd -m -p $(openssl passwd -6 $COCKPIT_USER_PASSWORD) -s /bin/bash $COCKPIT_USERNAME; sudo usermod -aG sudo $COCKPIT_USERNAME; mkdir -p /home/$COCKPIT_USERNAME/.ssh; mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/cockpit.socket.d

postRestore.name: Restart cockpit
postRestore.command: systemctl enable --now cockpit.socket; systemctl restart cockpit.socket
